mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 20-day periods following FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.25%, S&P 500 returns are negative in >55% of instances or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that precedes policy stimulus and economic recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.5% for two months, S&P 500 returns are negative in >60% of subsequent 5-day periods or Rank IC ≤ 0.01 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both decline, S&P 500 returns are positive in >55% of subsequent 60-day periods or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 1.5% YoY) combined with rising rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.25%) signals premature monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL < 1.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.25% regime, S&P 500 returns are positive in >55% of 20-day periods or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained payroll growth above 150,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 150k) indicates strong labor market support for consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 150k, S&P 500 returns are negative in >55% of subsequent 5-day periods or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline exceeding 0.5% month-over-month (INDPRO < -0.5%) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO declines >0.5% MoM, S&P 500 returns are positive in >55% of subsequent 20-day periods or Rank IC ≤ -0.01 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP contraction (GDPC1 decline) and housing starts decline (HOUST < 500k) indicate broad economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 and HOUST both decline, S&P 500 returns are positive in >55% of subsequent 60-day periods or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY) combined with elevated unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) signals stagflation risk that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and UNRATE > 7.0% regime, S&P 500 returns are positive in >55% of subsequent 5-day periods or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.02.
